title: leads are counted apart from documents to decide
line: a person named on a real, undecided card is named next by the queue; one whose only open work is a lead (a memorial's listed relative, tools/plan.py's listed_relative_leads) is neither named nor passed over, since Catalog.waiting never counts a lead as a document and the queue never adds a confirmed person on a lead's account alone

steps.say: a census page names and cites four people, none yet decided: a real document waits on each

expect.why: Alicia Ahern's card is a real document to decide, so the queue names her

steps.say: a memorial's listed relative is a lead, hand-planted here as tools/plan.py would write one, on a person with nothing else open

expect.why: the lead is counted apart from documents to decide

a lead is not a document, a conflict, or an undecided key fact, so the queue never puts this person up at all: not named next, and not named among those passed over either, exactly as before the lead existed
